changeRecord.title: support removed
changeRecord.whyItMatters: Every support is part of the load path. Without it the load it carried must reach the remaining supports through the members -- spans double, cantilevers appear, moments and deflections multiply -- or, if the structure was not redundant enough, there is no equilibrium at all (a mechanism).
changeRecord.precondition: a support (other than the plane restraint of a plane frame)
